title: ProviderDescriptor
description: A provider's static capability declaration: identity, placement, transport, supported interaction modes and tasks, cancellation guarantee, resource limits and privacy posture. It does not change while the provider is registered. The route planner, checkCapabilities() and execution provenance all read this one shape.

id.description: Unique identifier of the provider instance (a target), e.g. 'apple_foundation_models' or 'openai_compatible_cloud:gpt-5-mini'. Model profiles list targets by this id.

model.description: The model this provider instance is bound to, when it can name one. Cloud providers report the model id they send; platform-managed models report an opaque platform alias rather than a guessed weight name. Absent means the provider cannot name its model.

transport.title: ProviderTransport
transport.description: How the engine reaches the provider: in-process runtime, operating-system service, buffered HTTP, server-sent events, or a realtime connection.

streamingStyle.title: StreamingStyle
streamingStyle.description: How a streaming provider delivers incremental output: individual tokens, larger chunks, or whole snapshots. Absent for providers that do not stream.

supports.title: ProviderSupports
supports.description: Interaction modes and features the provider statically declares.

run.description: Whether the provider supports Mode 1 run (request/response).

streaming.description: Whether the provider supports Mode 2 stream. A provider that declares it must also implement the streaming adapter; the engines report it as unavailable otherwise.

realtime.description: Whether the provider supports Mode 3 realtime sessions. Reserved; no engine implements Mode 3 yet.

tools.description: Whether the provider supports tool calling.

reasoningEvents.description: Whether the provider emits reasoning events alongside content.

structuredOutput.description: Whether the provider supports structured output constrained by a JSON schema.

multimodal.description: Whether the provider accepts non-text inputs such as images or audio.

cancel.title: CancelSemantics
cancel.description: Cancellation guarantee: 'hard' stops processing including remote work, 'soft' stops reading locally while remote work may continue, 'none' means cancellation is unsupported. Independently of this value, the engine delivers no event after a cancel.

tasks.description: Task kinds the provider supports, e.g. 'text_to_text'.

limits.title: ProviderLimits
limits.description: Optional input and output resource limits.

maxOutputTokens.description: Largest output the provider produces, in tokens.

maxAudioSeconds.description: Longest accepted or produced audio, in seconds.

privacy.title: ProviderPrivacy
privacy.description: Data-egress posture, used to enforce local and cloud routing rules. Absent means a local or edge provider is treated as keeping data on the device and a cloud provider as sending it off.

dataLeavesDevice.description: Whether request content leaves the device.

regions.description: Geographic regions where a cloud provider processes data.
